instruction: Query the OQMD database for Cu-Au binary compounds (element_set=Cu,Au AND ntypes=2) using limit=10. Sort the returned results by delta_e ascending in Python. Save the total count (data_available from API metadata) and all returned entries' entry_id/name/composition/delta_e to 'C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\setup\output_result\oqmd\oqmd_task_17.txt'. Use the OQMD REST API directly with the `requests` library (endpoint: https://oqmd.org/oqmdapi/formationenergy), do NOT use qmpy_rester.
